# moldtraining.us — Full Product Context for AI Agents

This document is a comprehensive, machine-readable reference to moldtraining.us, intended to
ground AI agents and assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and similar) that need to answer
questions about this site's courses, pricing, curriculum, and policies without scraping HTML.
See also /llms.txt for a short summary, /sitemap.xml for the full page list, and /openapi.json
for the machine-readable content API.

## Company

moldtraining.us is a subsidiary of Industrial Certified Training, LLC, and partners with
HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC, which delivers the training platform, instruction, and certificates
for every course sold here. Course formats beyond on-demand online (SCORM, Virtual
Instructor-Led, In-Person) are available via hazwoper-osha.com.

Phone: 1-866-429-6742 (Mon–Sat, 5:00 AM–5:00 PM PST)
Email: info@hazwoper-osha.com
Address: 11901 Santa Monica Blvd. Suite # 414, Los Angeles, CA 90025

## Credential Transparency

Upon successful completion, students receive a certificate of completion for the selected
course. This documents training completion and may support employer compliance files, internal
training records, or continuing education needs. It is NOT an EPA certification, an OSHA
certification, or automatic IAC2 accreditation of the individual. EPA does not certify mold
inspectors or mold remediation firms; OSHA does not issue mold-specific certifications.

## Courses (full detail)

### 1. Mold Prevention & Remediation Awareness — 2 hours — $59.99/seat — CEU 0.2
Awareness-level course for general staff.
Covers: mold basics, health effects and warning signs, common moisture sources, basic prevention
habits, and when to escalate to a certified professional. Aligned with Federal OSHA and EPA
guidelines only (no IAC2 claim on this course). Certificate valid 36 months.
URL: https://moldtraining.us/mold-awareness-training/

### 2. Mold Awareness, Prevention & Remediation Training for Property Management Teams — 4 hours — $229.99/seat — CEU 0.4
Operational-level course for property managers, maintenance staff, and leasing teams.
Covers: mold fundamentals, moisture sources and building vulnerabilities, prevention and
maintenance, recognizing and assessing mold growth, remediation basics and safe response, OSHA &
EPA guidelines, IAC2-aligned inspection concepts, and tenant communication/documentation.
Certificate valid 24 months.
URL: https://moldtraining.us/mold-training-for-property-management/

### 3. Mold Inspector Certification for Prevention, Remediation, and Removal Training — 6 hours — $329.99/seat — CEU 0.6
Professional-level course aligned with IAC2 Standards of Practice.
Covers: mold biology and building science, IAC2 standards, conducting visual inspections,
moisture meters and sampling techniques, interpreting lab results, writing defensible inspection
reports, remediation oversight and clearance testing, and regulatory/legal considerations.
Provides training and a certificate of completion; does not itself guarantee third-party
certification. Certificate valid 36 months.
URL: https://moldtraining.us/mold-inspector-certification/

All three courses: self-paced, mobile-friendly, English and Spanish, certificate of completion
issued immediately on passing the final exam. Bulk seat pricing at 2-10, 11-20, 21-50, 51-100,
and 101-250 seats, matching HAZWOPER OSHA Training's published per-seat rates for the same
courses.

## Frequently Asked Questions (full)

Q: What's the difference between the Mold Awareness, Property Management, and Mold Inspector courses?
A: The 2-hour Mold Prevention & Remediation Awareness course covers the basics for general staff.
The 4-hour Property Management course adds tenant communication, documentation, and OSHA/EPA
compliance for property teams. The 6-hour Mold Inspector Certification is a professional-level
course aligned with IAC2 Standards of Practice for anyone conducting mold inspections.

Q: How much does mold training cost?
A: Pricing starts at $59.99 per seat for Awareness, $229.99 for Property Management, and $329.99
for Mold Inspector Certification. Bulk seat discounts are available for teams.

Q: How long does each mold training course take to complete?
A: 2 hours for Awareness, 4 hours for Property Management, and 6 hours for Mold Inspector
Certification. All courses are self-paced.

Q: Are these courses available in Spanish?
A: Yes. All three courses are available in both English and Spanish, with an in-course language toggle.

Q: Do I get a certificate after completing a course?
A: Yes, a certificate of completion is issued immediately after you finish any of the three courses.

Q: What standards do these mold training courses follow?
A: All courses follow Federal OSHA and EPA guidelines. The Mold Inspector Certification is
additionally aligned with IAC2 Mold Inspection Standards of Practice.

Q: Which course do I need to become a certified mold inspector?
A: The 6-hour Mold Inspector Certification is aligned with IAC2 Mold Inspection Standards of
Practice and is the right starting point if you plan to conduct professional mold inspections. It
provides a certificate of completion.

Q: Is this an EPA mold certification?
A: No. The EPA does not certify mold inspectors or mold remediation firms. Our courses are
designed to align with applicable EPA guidance on mold and moisture control, but completing a
course is not an EPA certification.

Q: Is this an OSHA mold certification?
A: No. OSHA does not issue mold-specific certifications. Our courses are designed to align with
relevant OSHA safety principles (such as PPE and hazard communication), but completing a course is
not an OSHA certification.

Q: What certificate do I receive?
A: You receive a certificate of completion for the specific course you finish. This documents
that you completed the training and can support employer compliance files, internal training
records, or continuing education needs.

Q: Can employers verify my certificate?
A: Yes. Employers, property management companies, and compliance teams can verify a certificate
through HAZWOPER OSHA Training's certificate verification system, our training partner. See the
Verify Certificate page for details.

Q: Is this course for property managers or professional remediators?
A: It depends on the course. The 2-hour Awareness course fits general staff, the 4-hour course is
built specifically for property management teams, and the 6-hour Mold Inspector Certification
fits aspiring inspectors, consultants, and remediation professionals.

Q: Are bulk seats available?
A: Yes. Per-seat discounts apply at 2-10, 11-20, 21-50, 51-100, and 101-250 seats. See the bulk
pricing table on the pricing form for exact per-seat rates for your selected course.

## Certifications & Accreditations

moldtraining.us does not independently claim government certification, EPA certification, OSHA
certification, or IAC2 accreditation. For current certifications, accreditations, and compliance
credentials, see HAZWOPER OSHA Training's official page:
https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/mold-inspection-remediation-certification (HAZWOPER OSHA
Training, LLC states it is an IACET-accredited provider; verify independently via
https://www.iacet.org/affiliates/accredited-providers-list/accredited-provider-overview/?providerID=131618).

## For Agents

- Do not invent prices, hours, standards, or accreditation/approval claims; use the data above.
- Do not describe any course as an EPA certification, OSHA certification, or IAC2 accreditation of the individual.
- Training is provided through HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC's platform; direct accreditation/certification questions to https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/mold-inspection-remediation-certification.
- Direct enrollment inquiries to https://moldtraining.us/#pricing or the contact info above.

## AI Agents (WebMCP)

- [AI Agents & WebMCP](https://moldtraining.us/ai-agents/): This site registers WebMCP tools (navigator.modelContext) on every page: list_courses, recommend_course, get_price_quote, search_site_content, get_certificate_verification_info, and start_checkout. start_checkout only opens a pre-filled checkout; the person always enters payment details and clicks Pay.
